task: On-policy distillation in slime 540ea919 (upstream examples/on_policy_distillation, sglang teacher mode): student Qwen3.5-9B, teacher Qwen3.5-27B, dapo-math-17k, 16 prompts x 4 samples, 8K responses, colocated on 4 GPUs: student actor TP2 x CP2 = DP1, 2 student sglang engines x TP2, teacher sglang server TP4

rollout.clock: rollout manager: end of rollout k-1 (after the judge's dump) -> end of rollout k

prime.note: an untimed rollout run of the same tree and switches (forced lengths: the timed run's own shapes) fills the compile caches of the generation path (sglang: flash-linear-attention's Triton autotuning is keyed on the token count); the timed run starts from a copy, one priming per side per pair (both runs of a reference pair share it)

train.clock: Megatron ranks: before train step k -> before train step k+1, slowest rank; step i trains on fixture dump dump_order[i], so the warm-up (steps 0..3) runs dump 4 and the timed steps' data (dumps 1..3) once and every shape-dependent first use (Triton autotuning and compilation) happens before the clock; windows = steps 4..6. Dump 4 belongs in the warm-up because step 7's forward passes on it run before step 7's clock, inside window 6 (with dump 0 first, 15.5 s of autotuning landed there, 11-17)

full.clock: rollout manager: end of rollout k-1 -> end of rollout k (one RL step: train k-1, weight sync, rollout k)

prime.note: stage 1 (the training path): an untimed train-mode run of the same tree and switches on fixture dumps 0..4 (the full loop's own shapes: forced lengths, same prompts) fills the compile caches; with TRITON_CACHE_AUTOTUNING=1 they hold Triton's autotune results too

stage 2 (the generation path): an untimed rollout run on the same forced lengths, starting from stage 1's caches, so sglang's own first uses are cached as well; the timed run starts from a copy of the two stages together (one priming per tree: the final evaluation's reference A and B share theirs)

teacher.clock: teacher replay: rollout k's samples of the fixture scored through the tree's reward path (all at once), first request -> post-processing done

invalid_run_signatures.reason: torch.compile hit its recompile limit (the timed code fell back to eager)
Inductor skipped the CUDA graphs it was asked for
sglang failed to capture its CUDA graphs
an NCCL collective timed out (the run recovered or hung)

teacher_rules.note: teacher side: candidate replay vs the frozen stock replay of the same tokens; the reference's own spread pools the unchanged teacher re-batched four ways (rebatchings) against all at once: the hybrid model's linear-attention state crosses prefill chunk boundaries, so any other batching moves the tokens after them, while repeats of one batching are bitwise; the floors only guard a zero spread
